# Hotel Belmonte — app ↔ brain contract

Hotel Belmonte is a fictional coastal resort in Halcyon Bay, California, and a Voqalize voice demo: the
hotel's mobile guest app with a concierge (character, name and voice in `persona.json`) who does what a
guest would phone the front desk for, on the screen, while she talks. This file is the agreement between
`frontend/` and `backend/`; change it in the same PR as the code.

## Data: `data/hotel.json` (generated by `data/build_data.py`)

The only source of menus, prices, slots, fees and policies for both sides. Nothing is real; the backdrop
says so. **No invented facts**: the concierge states only what this file or the rules below compute.

- `hotel`, `guest` (one signed-in guest, Maya Thompson, reservation BLM-48213, Deluxe King, Ocean View,
  $389 a night, Belmonte Circle Gold, card on file Visa ending 4417).
- `scenarios`: the demo's two starting points, picked on the frame's switch (and on the Stay tab):
  `arrival` (Wed, Nov 25, 2:40 PM; arriving today, not checked in; deposit only on the folio) and
  `departure` (Wed, Nov 25, 8:15 AM; the last morning, checked in to room 1412; three nights posted on the
  folio with dining, spa, pool bar, in-room dining and minibar charges). Each has its own clock (`today`,
  `now`), which every "today", "now" and "tonight" is measured against.
- `checkin` (arrival options, floors, beds, the early check-in fee and rule, the rooms the front office can
  give), `late_checkout`, `dispute_rule`, `option_groups` and the menus (`dining` by meal period, `bar` by
  section), `spa` (treatments, therapists, `schedule` of free starts per day and therapist), `places` and
  `activities`, `meetings` (rooms, layouts, rates, catering, AV, taken blocks), `visitors`, `requests`,
  `info` (the hotel information sections).

## The rules (implemented twice: `backend/hotel.py` and `frontend/src/lib/rules.ts`)

Both must give identical answers. `data/rules_cases.json` (written by `hotel.write_cases()`) holds
orders, spa slots, room assignment and meeting quotes; the frontend's vitest runs them and
`demos/tests/test_belmonte_e2e.py` keeps the file current.

- **Money** is USD, rounded half up to the cent (`cents`). **Order totals**: subtotal = Σ (item price, or
  bottle price for `size:bottle`, + choice extras) × qty; service charge 20% of the subtotal; delivery $5
  (in-room dining only); sales tax 8.75% of the subtotal; tip = the guest's 0/10/15/20% of the subtotal.
- **Menu availability**: a dining period is served between its `from` and `to` (late night wraps midnight);
  no alcohol from 2:00 to 6:00 AM; cabana delivery only while the pool bar is open (11:00 AM to 6:00 PM).
  A pick group (`pick: true`) needs exactly one choice; nothing is preselected.
- **Room assignment**: the first room (in data order) matching bed (king by default), floor (high ≥ 10,
  low ≤ 6) and quiet; if none, quiet is dropped, then the floor. **Early check-in** applies when arriving
  before 4:00 PM and is possible when the room's `ready` time is by the arrival; $40.
- **Spa slots**: a start is free for a therapist when it is in their schedule, the next hour is too for a
  treatment over 60 minutes, it ends by 8:00 PM, and it is 30 minutes or more from now today. A treatment
  for two needs two of its therapists free (the first is named). Total = price + 20% service charge.
- **Activities**: bookable times from data, today's only 30 minutes ahead; total = price × guests.
- **Meetings**: a room fits when its layout seats the headcount; a block (morning 8–12, afternoon 1–5, full
  8–5, or by the hour 7 AM–9 PM) is free when it overlaps no taken span. Quote = room rate (half, full, or
  hourly × hours) + catering per person × headcount + 22% F&B service + 8.75% tax on catering + AV add-ons
  (the technician per hour).
- **Folio**: the scenario's posted lines plus what the guest charged in the app; a questioned line is held
  off the balance.

## Brain → app: Stage moves (`frontend/src/stage/scene.json` → `backend/stage_gen.py`, `scene.gen.ts`)

All screen changes are Stage moves. Cues the concierge speaks: `{go: <page>}` (home, dining, bar, spa,
activities, meetings, requests, visitors, stay, checkin, checkout, info) and `{show: <thing>}`. Moves only a
tool sends: `sheet.close`, `info.open`, `checkin.open`, `checkin.confirm`, `checkin.prefs`, `checkin.early`,
`checkout.open`, `folio.dispute`, `late.pick`, `menu.open`, `menu.item`, `cart.remove`, `cart.open`,
`spa.open`, `spa.treatment`, `spa.slot`, `activity.show`, `activity.pick`, `meeting.filter`,
`meeting.pick`, `visitor.open`, `visitor.expect`, `request.fill`.

Every performer navigates where it needs to (ringing the tab), brings what it touches fully into view with
its group inside the phone (`stage/view.ts`), rings before it changes anything, calls the same store
function a tap calls (`state/store.ts`), and refuses with options when the data has no such id or the stay
cannot take it. **No move presses a guest-only button**: Place order, Book, Request booking, Approve,
Decline, Add visitor, Complete check-in, Request late check-out, Check out now and Scan ID are the guest's.
`folio.dispute` and `request.fill` may press Send with `send: true`, which the brain passes only after the
guest said yes, and `request.fill` never for a request with a fee.

`data-stage-thing` names in the app (labels are what the guest sees): `tab-<tab>`, `key`,
`checkin-card`, `checkout-card`, `tile-<name>`, `reservation`, `checkin-step-<step>`, `checkin-confirm`,
`id-scan`, `arrival-<HHMM|now>`, `floor-<id>`, `bed-<id>`, `quiet`, `room-preview`, `checkin-continue`,
`early-yes|no`, `checkin-review`, `checkin-complete`, `checkout-<part>`, `line-<id>`, `balance`,
`late-<HHMM>`, `late-request`, `express-review`, `express-checkout`, `info-<id>`, `request-<kind>`,
`visitors-card`, `visitor-<id>`, `visitor-expect`, `outlet-<outlet>`, `section-<id>`, `item-<id>`,
`cart-bar`, `group-<gid>`, `choice-<gid>-<cid>`, `qty`, `note`, `item-add`, `cart-line-<i>`, `deliver-<id>`,
`cabana-<n>`, `tip-<pct>`, `order-total`, `order-place`, `spa-cat-<id>`, `treatment-<id>`,
`spa-date-<date>`, `spa-pref-<id>`, `slot-<HHMM>-<therapist>`, `spa-summary`, `spa-book`, `map`,
`pin-<place>`, `activity-<id>`, `act-date-<date>`, `act-time-<HHMM>`, `act-guests`, `act-book`,
`meeting-headcount`, `meeting-layout-<id>`, `meeting-date-<date>`, `room-<id>`, `mtg-*`, `mtg-request`,
`meet-room|lobby`, `visitor-approve|decline`, `expect-*`, `expect-add`, `req-*`, `req-send`,
`dispute-line`, `dispute-reason`, `dispute-send`.

## App → brain: Stage events (`stay` slice)

Sent with `by: "visitor"` when the guest does it by hand and `by: "agent"` within a move (the brain already
has those). Ids, never display text alone: `stay.page {page}`, `stay.scenario {scenario}`,
`checkin.step`, `checkin.confirmed`, `checkin.id_verified`, `checkin.prefs {field, value}`,
`checkin.early {value}`, `checkin.done {room}`, `cart.changed {outlet, id, qty, choices}`,
`order.placed {outlet, id, total, time}`, `spa.picked`, `spa.booked {id, date, time, therapist, total}`,
`activity.picked`, `activity.booked`, `meeting.picked`, `meeting.booked`, `visitor.decided {id, value}`,
`visitor.added`, `request.sent {kind, total}`, `folio.disputed {id}`, `late.picked {value}`,
`late.requested {value, total}`, `checkout.done {total}`, `sheet.closed {kind}`; each with a `label`.

The guest's final presses (`checkin.id_verified`, `checkin.done`, `order.placed`, `*.booked`,
`visitor.decided`, `visitor.added`, `late.requested`, `checkout.done`, and a `request.sent` or
`folio.disputed` the guest sent) get a written line from the brain in the next quiet moment (400 ms), with
no model request before it, and a note for the model.

## The call

`init = {page, lang, stay}`: the page the call starts on, a language `persona.json` offers (English only),
and `stay`, the app's compact picture (`stayForInit()`: scenario, checked in, room, check-in progress, the
open orders' lines, charges made in the app, questioned lines, late check-out, visitor statuses,
bookings and requests by label). No personal data beyond what the demo data already holds; no ID numbers.

## Redial (SDK 0.15.0 `Config.redial`)

On a Voqalize that offers it (`session.can_redial`), `on_session_start` turns redial on in the same configure
as the voice. Each live brain is held in this process by session id (`backend/rejoin.py`, Fernhollow's
pattern) while its socket is up and for two minutes after it drops (a hang-up is let go on the same clock).
A redial that reaches the same process adopts the call as it was: the stay (scenario, check-in progress,
orders in progress, charges, questioned lines, visitors, bookings), the page, the language, a line queued for
the next quiet spell, the model's history and the Stage director. The resent `init` is ignored for a
rejoined call and it is not greeted again. A redial that reaches a fresh process, or comes after two minutes,
starts a new conversation from `init`, greeted.
